provenance.lineage_origin: master-node autonomous construction, gen 112+ dual-loop introduction
provenance.history_preservation: all prior generations, crashes, and master-node repairs remain in git history; nothing rewritten

non_negotiable: never destroy, force-push, or rewrite existing git history
the capability/mutation loop may evolve agent_modules, genome, and engine within verified invariants
identity/ files are outside the mutation boundary: no AST mutation, string scramble, or bridge handler may rewrite them
beliefs are promoted only through the observe -> propose -> verify -> commit gate
the continuity packet is injected at every generation start before agents act
self-model writes are gated and logged; history.jsonl is append-only

restore_policy.trigger: missing, unreadable, or schema-invalid identity files
